engineering_and_research_handoff: Request the official 2010 demarcation protocol with map sheets/coordinate schedules, plus relevant joint-inspection marker register and current inspection records; identify the segment and preserve authority, datum, scale, vintage and reuse terms.

Only after obtaining those records, compare their line/coordinates to the immutable fragment under independent geospatial review; do not infer the line from generalized ADM2 boundaries or annex administrative names.

Assess physical surface separately using licensed multi-date imagery plus suitable terrain and seasonal-hydrology sources; record dates, resolution and uncertainty. WorldCover 2021 v200 is a possible coarse lead, not a result.
A Tajik chronicle PDF endpoint was attempted but its presented TLS certificate hostname did not match the requested host; it was not fetched or analyzed. No certificate validation bypass was used.
decision: The bilateral legal framework and separate authoritative demarcation-record chain are better documented, but the local demarcated line and candidate physical surface remain unresolved. Preserve the current bounded no-correction proposal; do not infer ownership, dry land or boundary location.
